# Real-Time Manim (RTM)

> Vulkan-accelerated, real-time rendering backend for ManimCE: drives ManimCE's own Mobject/Animation model through a native Vulkan pipeline — live 1920x1080@60 window, 1.9–2.8x faster MP4 recording, O(1) frame seeking, MathTex via an in-process Typst backend. A Python library (no manim CLI); import `real_time_manim`, never `import manim` first. Python >= 3.11, Windows 10+/macOS, ffmpeg on PATH for recording.

Start with the agent-facing condensed reference (`RTM-Wiki/agent/README.md`) — it has the facts, hard constraints, entry points, execution modes, a file map, and a suggested read order. The human manual lives in `RTM-Wiki/zh_CN/` (source of truth) and `RTM-Wiki/en_US/`; the source tree is `real_time_manim/`. On any doc conflict, the source tree wins. Report bugs as issues with a minimal runnable Scene; wiki errors are fixed by PR, not issues.
